book.name: Yoan
book.title: Vaaru poia tau Yoan iboode Jon—John

content: Yesu iburig pa mateegh

Umbom patabuyaaŋ isov, ve saawe imin maata to wik tana, mboŋoozo, ndoroome geeg, ve Maria to Magdala ila ighe igig naal to Yesu. Ila ivot maet puura tau tighur Yesu paata pani na, ve ighita maet tiina tau ipoon naal aavo na, tipatambulia ighau wa.

Tauvene ilaan imuul ila to Simon Petrus ve mbiwa tau Yesu loolo igheen tooni kat na, ve ipaes pazi ighe: “Nugh eta tipas Tiina toit paata pa naal, ve tighamu ila wa! Ve yei nikankaan pani. Tighuru sindei?”
Tauvene Petrus yesuru mbiwa ite tawe tiburig tila pa naal.
Yesuru tilaan tila, ve mbiwa ite tana ilaan rekia imuuŋ pa Petrus gha ila ivot naal aavo imin maata.
Ra itugh ghi izi, ve igig iloŋ ila pa naal loolo, ve ighita uuli siriv siriv tau tikau Yesu paata pani na, ighengheen ila niia. Eemon i iloŋ ila naal loolo mako.
Malau mako, Simon Petrus aana ilam peria, ve malmali iloŋ ila naal loolo. I paam ighita uuli siriv siriv tau tikau Yesu paata pani na, ighengheen.
Ve ighita uuli tau tikau Yesu daaba pani na, igheen tomania uuli siriv siriv tawe mako. Ene polaaŋni izi igheen soghan.
Ra mbiwa ite tau ila ivot naal aavo imin maata na, aana itaghon Petrus iloŋ ila. I ighita gabua naol tana, ve ighur ila.
Onoon, Maaron aliiŋa tau tiboode na, isaav tauvene: Mesia aat imaat ve iburig pa mateegh itaghon Maaron ŋgar tooni. Eemon ŋgar toozi ighazooŋ pa saveeŋ tana puughu soone.
Yesuru tighita gabua tana le isov, ra tipul naal, ve timuul tila pa niazi to lepoogh.
Yesu ivot to Maria to nugh Magdala
Maria to Magdala imuul ila ivot naal aavo, gha iyozyooz ve itaŋtaŋ. Ve itugh ghi izi, ve igig iloŋ ila pa naal loolo
le ighita aŋela ru tilepleep. Yesuru tinonogh zi pa nonoghiiŋa pisosooŋa, ve mbolezi izi nugh tau tighur Yesu paata pani na. Ee ileep ila pa daaba, ve ite ileep ila pa aaghe.
Aŋela ru tawe tighasoni tighe: “Livaa, yo utaŋtaŋ pasaa?” I iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Wai, tigham Tiina tsiau paata ila wa. Ve yau nakankaan pani. Tighuru sindei?”
Ra itoor ghi, maata imuul, ve ighita Yesu tauu iyozyooz. Eemon ighilaalo mako.

Yesu ighasoni ighe: “Livaa, utaŋ pasaa? Uil sei?” Maria ighe pa i uraata eta tau iŋgin nugh tawe. Tauvene isaav pani ighe: “Olman, isaav ighe yo ugham Tiina tsiau paata ila nugh eta, na upaes payau: Ughuru sindei? Leso nala naghamu.”

Tauvene Yesu isaav pani ighe: “Maria.” I isaav tauvene, ra Maria ighilaalo ighe ene Yesu tauta ene. Tauvene itoor ghi naagho ila pani, ve isaav pani ila saveeŋ Hibru ighe: “Raboni!” Saveeŋ tane, puughu vene: ‘Paduduŋaaŋ tsiau.’

Yesu isaav pani muul ighe: “Usaghav ghau sov. Pa saawe to nazala to Tamaŋ, ene soone. Umuul ula to tazigŋa, ve upaes pazi tauvene: Yau pale namuul nazala to Tamaŋ. I, yam Tamamim paam. Ve i Maaron tsiau, ve Maaron tsiam paam.”
Tauvene Maria to nugh Magdala ila ivot to yes mbiwa, ve ipaes pazi ighe: “Yau naghita Tiina toit pa taug matag wa!” Ra ipaesia Yesu aliiŋa pazi gha tilooŋa.
Yesu ivot to mbiwa tooni

Saawe eemon tana, ravrav tooni, yes mbiwa to Yesu tilup zi iloŋ ila ruum ee loolo ve tipoon ataman le tuŋia kat. Pasaa, tiroi pa yes Yuda. Malau mako na, Yesu ivot iyooz ila sosozi, ve isaav pazi ighe: “Luuma to Maaron
igheen tomani gham.”
Ra itotoi niima ve raŋraaŋo saamba pazi. Yes tighita Tiina toozi, ve lolozi poia le poia kat.
Yesu isaav pazi muul ighe: “Luuma to Maaron igheen tomani gham. Aazne, yau nambaaŋ gham ala, imin Tamaŋ imbaaŋ ghau nalam ne.”
Ra iviv avuvu ila pazi, ve isaav pazi ighe: “Agham Avuvu Patabuyaaŋ irau gham.
Isaav ighe yam apul sosor to tamtamon eta, ene Maaron paam ireu sosor tooni. Ve tamtamon tau ighe apul sosor tooni mako, ene Maaron paam irau ireu sosor tooni mako.”
Yesu ivot to Tomas
Saawe tau Yesu ivot to mbiwa tooni, tamtamon toozi ee, eeza Tomas, ileep tomani zi mako. Tomas tawe, eeza ite Didimus.

Tauvene murei, ra tipaes pani tighe: “Yei nighita Tiina toit wa!” Eemon Tomas iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Ah, isaav ighe taug matag naghita kiruuŋ niia tau igheen ila niima na, ve nazeev nimag ŋguruuŋa itaghon kiruuŋ niia tawe, ve nazeev nimag iloŋ ila iiz niia ta raŋraaŋo saamba na, ene aat naghur ila. Ve ighe mako, ene irau naghur ila saveeŋ tsiam tana mako!”

Mboŋ liim ve ru ilam ila, ra mbiwa tooni tilup zi muul iloŋ ila ruum tau tilepleep pani na. Saawe tana, Tomas ileep tomani zi paam. Yes tiponaar ataman tisov tivolaar le tuŋia. Malau mako, Yesu ivot iyooz ila sosozi, ve isaav pazi ighe: “Luuma to Maaron ileep tomani gham.”
Ra isaav pa Tomas ighe: “Ulam ugharau, ve ughita nimag, uzeev nimam ŋguruuŋa itaghon kiruuŋ niia, ve uzeev nimam iloŋ ila iiz niia tau igheen raŋraŋog saamba ne. Yo lolom ruru irao! Ughur ila!”
Tomas iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Yo Tiina tsiau, ve Maaron tsiau!”

Yesu isaav pani muul ighe: “Yo ughit ghau pa taum matam, tauta ughur ilam tsiau. Ve yes tau tighit ghau pa matazi mako, ve tighur ilam tsiau, ene yes aat tintinizi pa poia to Maaron tau pale izaa toozi.”
Rau tane puughu
Yesu igham gabua ŋgeretazi katini ila mbiwa tooni matazi, leso itotoi tauu pazi ve tighilaal tighe Maaron ileep tomania pa uraat tooni. Eemon saveeŋa siriv igheen ila rau tane mako.
Ve saveeŋ isov tau igheen ila rau tane, ene to ipaghazoŋai ŋgar tsiam ve igham gham aghur ila to Yesu aghe i Mesia ve Maaron tauu Naatu. Leso i ndaamo payam ve agham lepoogh poia ila to Maaron.

footnotes.text: Luuma to Maaron ilup gabua naol. Yesu ibaad sosor toit atuya wa, tauvene Maaron aate yavyav pait muul mako, ve itiŋa Maaron irau tavalupu ghiit tamin eemon. Ve Maaron igham ghiit taroi muul mako, ve loloon ipataŋan muul mako. Loloon poia. Ve aazne, ezaan pa ghamuuŋ lepoogh poia to Maaron tau iseeŋga taghon gha ila.

Saveeŋ tane, puughu tauvene: Isaav ighe tamtamon eta ighur ila to Krisi, ene pale Maaron ireu sosor tooni. Tamtamon tauvene, iit irau tasaav pani taghe: “Maaron ireu sosor tsio wa.” Ve isaav ighe tamtamon eta ighur ila mako, ene itotoi ighe i ileep iloŋ ila pooz to Maaron soone. Tamtamon tauvene, iit aat tasaav ghazooŋa pani: Maaron ireu sosor tooni soone.
